title: `tadu close --write` reports success but leaves a CommonMark lazy continuation in TODO.md instead of moving it into TODO_LOG.md
notes: Reproduced on 2026-10-21 in an isolated fixture: an indented continuation ends with an open inline-code span, the next line starts at column zero and closes that span, and close moves only the indented prefix. The original central unbacked-inventory record hit this case; its full text was preserved and the archival output repaired manually. Smallest step: add a regression fixture for lazy paragraph/inline-code continuations and make close move the entire list item or fail without writing. No source fix is claimed.
result: Close now refuses possible adjacent unindented continuations before planning or writing; indent the full item or move it manually. EOF, blank separators and known checklist/heading/comment boundaries remain accepted. Independent read-only review returned no findings.
evidence: Original write regressions failed before the fix (2 failed, 6 passed); the complete AGENTS gate passed 377 tests and 100% coverage plus Ruff, mypy, codeality-py check, deptry and pip-audit. An installed-CLI fixture returns exit 2 with both files byte-for-byte unchanged.
